fields.statement: Building ArgentSea Core with Configuration=Release and Platform=AnyCPU compiles with Optimize enabled (Optimize=true); building with Configuration=Debug and Platform=AnyCPU compiles with Optimize disabled (Optimize=false). No other configuration/platform combination is declared, so any other combination falls back to MSBuild's own default rather than a project-declared value. Every build of the project also produces a companion NuGet symbol package in snupkg format (IncludeSymbols=true, SymbolPackageFormat=snupkg); this symbol-packaging setting is declared twice, in two separate PropertyGroup elements with identical content, which is a literal redundancy in the project file rather than two distinct settings.
fields.scope: ArgentSea Core build configuration and symbol packaging (ArgentSea.Shared/src/ArgentSea.csproj PropertyGroups).
